changes.before: Initial 45 days; extended 10 months and 15 days; expires 2027-01-21 unless changed
changes.after: Ordinance 2272: 45 days after January 21, 2026 adoption, with section 12 stating March 7, 2026 scheduled expiry unless extended. changes.before: Ordinance No. 2272; extension Ordinance No. 2274; Gov. Code sections 36937 and 65858
changes.after: Signed Ordinance 2272 adopted January 21, 2026, five ayes, initially restricting Saturn Park; signed extension Ordinance 2274 adopted March 4, five ayes, applies citywide. Both section 11 clauses provide immediate effect on adoption under Government Code sections 36937 and 65858. The 2274 relative-term clauses and explicit January 21, 2027 sunset use different anchors; no actual end date is inferred.

changes.before: Urgency Ordinance 2276 adopted April 20, 2026 established a citywide data center prohibition effective immediately upon adoption. Ordinance 2279 adopted May 6 ties its effective date to Measure NDC. Measure NDC passed June 2 with 10,388 Yes and 1,372 No; the clerk certified the canvass June 30 and Council declared adoption by Resolution 2026-R56 on July 1. The attached proposition bears a July 2 adoption date and specifies effect 10 days after Council certification. Exact termination of the separate temporary moratorium and subsequent legal changes remain unresolved.
changes.after: Urgency Ordinance 2276 adopted April 20, 2026 established a citywide data center prohibition effective immediately upon adoption. Ordinance 2279 adopted May 6 ties its effective date to Measure NDC. Measure NDC passed June 2 with 10,388 Yes and 1,372 No; the clerk certified the canvass June 30 and Council declared adoption by Resolution 2026-R56 on July 1. The attached proposition bears a July 2 adoption date and specifies effect 10 days after Council certification. Exact termination of the separate temporary moratorium and subsequent legal changes remain unresolved. Signed Ordinances 2272 and 2274 now directly confirm adoption, immediate-effect clauses, and the Saturn Park-to-citywide scope change. The extension contains differing relative-term and explicit-sunset anchors; its actual termination is not established by the later permanent ban’s conflict-priority clause.
